area.title: Heating zone
area.description: Choose an area to see nearby temperature sensors first, or leave it blank to start with all areas.

area_temperatures.title: Temperature sensors in the preferred area
area_temperatures.description: Suggestions for **{area}**, in priority order: {suggestions}. Choose a sensor here or continue to the All areas picker.

temperatures.title: Temperature sensors · All areas
temperatures.description: Confirm or change your selections. This list includes temperature sensors from every area and unassigned sensors.

data_description.backup_temperature: LAHEMS2 uses this sensor if the primary reading is unusable.
data_description.temperature_max_age_minutes: Maximum time since Home Assistant last reported a temperature. Applies to primary, backup, outdoor and stove room temperature sensors.

heat.title: Heat sources
heat.description: Select the heat pump thermostat. Its current setpoint is the comfort baseline. The pellet heat-request switch and separate meters are optional.

data.shared_circuit: The heat sources share a hydraulic circuit

data_description.pellet_heat_request: Select the switch entity for your heat request, such as an ESPHome relay. LAHEMS2 reads its current state.

energy.title: Grid, prices, solar and EV
energy.description: Confirm one primary grid meter and review the suggested price and solar sources. You can leave prices blank and add them later.

data.ev_schedule: Scheduled EV power from the external controller

data_description.tariff_max_age_minutes: Maximum time since Home Assistant last reported an import or export price. Use 15 minutes for a source that reports each quarter-hour tariff.

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Enter the measurements, limits, and controller for battery {number}. Select Add another battery to include an additional battery.

review.title: Review your bindings
review.description:
LAHEMS2 runs in **{mode}**. Saving starts read-only monitoring.

{readings}

error.invalid_area: This area no longer exists. Select another area or leave the area blank.
error.required_entity: Select an entity for this role.
error.invalid_entity: Select an enabled entity of the expected type.
error.unreadable_relay: The switch must report On or Off before it can be added.
error.invalid_number: Enter a value within the displayed limits.
error.required_setting: Enter a value for this battery setting.
